description: Change mission state. Complete with notes; record decisions separately with rbook_decisions(action="record", missionId). Every action needs missionId; block and reopen also need reason. Each writes the status and its history; start may activate its Planned sprint, and complete writes decisions[], updates and snapshots the context. Any may upload owed checkpoints. Plan or edit missions with rbook_mission. Calls may log usage.

decisions.description: Prefer rbook_decisions record, one call per decision

deferUntil.description: A day makes it due then; else a hint

targetStatus.description: start: Current promotes without starting; unblock: override inferred state
